retrievalProfile.description: A monochromatic red-tinted group portrait set against a high-contrast urban skyline, featuring 1970s-style script and serif typography.
excludeWhen: modern clean minimalist design is required
futuristic or high-tech themes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a central group of four men in 1970s attire, overlaid on a dense, high-angle cityscape. The entire image is unified by a warm, reddish-brown duotone filter that flattens the depth and creates a nostalgic, printed feel.
coreVisualRelationships: Hierarchical text placement at top and bottom margins
Monochromatic color harmony across all elements
Pyramidal group arrangement for visual stability
coreInvariants: High-contrast urban background with visible windows and architecture
70s-era fashion including plaid patterns and wide collars

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged in a diamond/pyramid formation, occupying the central and lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the foreground with a prominent plaid jacket.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large script title at the top, moves down through the faces of the group, and ends at the subtitle at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the cityscape and the subjects.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale cream or light pink (highlights and sky)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high contrast monochromatic scheme.
paletteRestrictions: No blues, greens, or secondary colors
Limited to a single-hue duotone range

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of elegant script and transitional serifs
letterConstructionRules: Script features high-contrast strokes and decorative swashes
Serif text uses italicized, high-contrast forms
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended swashes on initial capital letters in the script font
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Script for primary branding paired with a bold italic serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Circular logo emblem in bottom right corner
Subtle drop shadows to lift text from busy background

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the elegant, swash-heavy 70s script feel.
Provides the sturdy, high-readability serif contrast for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group portrait of four men in 1970s fashion (plaid jackets, turtlenecks, berets) arranged in a pyramid. Overlay this on a high-contrast, dense New York City skyline. Apply a monochromatic deep-red and cream duotone filter to the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, elegant white script title at the top center. Add a bold italicized white serif subtitle at the bottom center, ensuring it is legible against the dark clothing of the subjects.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic red/sepia?
Does the script font have decorative swashes?
Is the background a dense urban cityscape?

postGenerationChecks: Check for duotone consistency across text and image.
Ensure the script font does not obscure faces.
Verify the 'vintage print' texture is present.
Confirm the pyramidal group composition is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a duotone-filtered group portrait with a high-contrast cityscape and 70s-era script typography to create a nostalgic soul-music aesthetic.
